    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

def load():
    import os,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G

# Test: crop bbox of ALL nonbg, then remove all-bg rows/cols inside? 
def solve(I):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for row in I for v in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(r,c,I[r][c]) for r in range(len(I)) for c in range(len(I[0])) if I[r][c]!=bg]
    r0,r1=min(p[0] for p in pts),max(p[0] for p in pts)
    c0,c1=min(p[1] for p in pts),max(p[1] for p in pts)
    out=[[I[r-r0][c-c0] for c in range(c0,c1+1)] for r in range(r0,r1+1)]
    # remove all-bg rows and cols inside
    rows=[i for i in range(len(out)) if any(x!=bg for x in out[i])]
    cols=[j for j in range(len(out[0])) if any(out[i][j]!=bg for i in range(len(out)))]
    return [[out[i][j] for j in cols] for i in rows]

def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    cnt=Counter(v for row in gi for v in row)
    bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cc={v:[(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if gi[r][c]==v] for v in cnt}
    fc=None;bb=None
    for v,ps in cc.items():
        if v==bgc or len(ps)!=4: continue
        b=box(ps)
        if {(b[0],b[1]),(b[0],b[3]),(b[2],b[1]),(b[2],b[3])}<=set(ps):
            fc=v;bb=b;break
    objs={v:p for v,p in cc.items() if v!=fc}
    r0,r1,c0,c1=bb
    Ht,Wt=r1-r0+1,c1-c0+1
    # crop frame bbox with frame color background
    out=[[fc]*Wt for _ in range(Ht)]
    def norm(ps):
        ps=list(ps); r0=min(a for a,b in ps); c0=min(b for a,b in ps)
        return frozenset((a-r0,b-c0) for a,b in ps)
    for v,p in sorted(objs.items(),key=lambda kv:-abs(sum(kv[1])/len(kv[1])-Ht/2)+abs(sum(x[1] for x in kv[1])/len(kv[1])-Wt/2)):
        ob=norm(p)
        best=None
        for dr in range(Ht):
            for dc in range(Wt):
                pl=[(dr+a,dc+b) for a,b in ob]
                if any(not(0<=a<Ht and 0<=b<Wt) for a,b in pl): continue
                if any(out[a][b]!=fc for a,b in pl): continue
                sc=abs(dr-sum(ob)/len(ob))+abs(dc-(sum(b2 for a,b2 in ob)/len(ob)))
                key=(sc,dr,dc)
                if best is None or key<best: best=key
        _,dr,dc=best
        for a,b in ob: out[a+dr][b+dc]=v
    return out
for n in ['3','4','5']:
    gi=G[f'Demo pair {n} input']
    res=solve(gi)
    print(n,'match' if res==G[f'Demo pair {n} output'] else 'NO')
